1|#!/bin/zsh
2|# Final-exam session for the trained model: deploy deploy/modal_forge.py
3|# (app forge-trained), wait for ready, run runner_final.py calls one after
4|# another, each with --budget = the whole cap (the runner's own guard stops
5|# new calls at the $0.30 reserve; budget_left.py below is only the
6|# refuse-to-start check, so time and reserve are not subtracted twice),
7|# optional pilot + GO/STOP file pause, always stops the app and prints
8|# whether it stopped. Same behaviour as experiments/freecad/run_fc_session.sh,
9|# for runner_final.py with app forge-trained.
10|# Usage: run_final_session.sh <absolute-out-dir> [cap-$] [--pilot <spec>] [--run <spec> ...]
11|# Each spec is "<jobs>:<subdir>:<arms>:<k>" (e.g. "main:main-FT:FT:3").
12|# jobs "dev" means the factory dev file (experiments/factory/jobs_dev.jsonl);
13|# anything else means --jobs <jobs> on the exam. Default pilot is the dev
14|# check (PLAN step 5 gate) and the default run is the final exam (step 6).
15|#
16|# Each runner call starts in the background (cmd & RPID=$!; wait $RPID) so
17|# the EXIT/INT/TERM/HUP trap can always run. The trap kills the runner and
18|# its children (kill -TERM $RPID; pkill -TERM -P $RPID; macOS has no setsid),
19|# then always runs `modal app stop forge-trained -y` and prints whether it
20|# stopped.
21|#
22|# Offline-test seams (env, all optional; production defaults unchanged):
23|#   RUN_SESSION_SKIP_DEPLOY=1  skip secret/deploy/ready, pretend URL=skip
24|#   MODAL_BIN               modal binary (default "modal"; stub it in tests)
25|set -u
26|FORGE=~/projects/forge
27|OUT=$1; shift
28|CAP=3.0
29|case "${1:-}" in
30|  [0-9]* ) CAP=$1; shift;;
31|esac
32|PILOT="dev:dev-FT:FT:3"
33|RUNS=()
34|while [ $# -gt 0 ]; do
35|  case "$1" in
36|    --pilot) PILOT=$2; shift 2;;
37|    --run) RUNS+=("$2"); shift 2;;
38|    *) echo "unknown arg $1"; exit 2;;
39|  esac
40|done
41|[ ${#RUNS[@]} -eq 0 ] && RUNS=("main:main-FT:FT:3")
42|mkdir -p "$OUT"
43|cd ~/projects/forge
44|COMMON=~/projects/forge/experiments/common
45|MODAL_BIN=${MODAL_BIN:-modal}
46|K=$(python3 -I -c "import secrets;print(secrets.token_urlsafe(32))")
47|echo "key generated (never printed)"
48|RPID=""
49|CLEANED=""
50|cleanup() {  # runs once: kill the runner + children, then stop the app
51|  [ -n "$CLEANED" ] && return 0
52|  CLEANED=1
53|  if [ -n "$RPID" ]; then
54|    kill -TERM "$RPID" 2>/dev/null || true
55|    pkill -TERM -P "$RPID" 2>/dev/null || true
56|  fi
57|  if "$MODAL_BIN" app stop forge-trained -y >/dev/null 2>&1; then
58|    echo "app stopped $(date +%T)"
59|  else
60|    echo "APP STOP FAILED"
61|  fi
62|}
63|trap 'cleanup' EXIT
64|trap 'cleanup; exit 143' INT TERM HUP
65|if [ "${RUN_SESSION_SKIP_DEPLOY:-}" = "1" ]; then
66|  date +"deploy start %T (skipped)"
67|  GPU_START=$(date +%s)
68|  URL="skip"
69|else
70|  "$MODAL_BIN" secret create forge-glimmer VLLM_API_KEY="$K" --force >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "secret updated"
71|  date +"deploy start %T"
72|  GPU_START=$(date +%s)
73|  DEP=$("$MODAL_BIN" deploy deploy/modal_forge.py 2>&1); echo "$DEP" | tail -3
74|  URL=$(echo "$DEP" | grep -oE 'https://[a-zA-Z0-9.-]+\.modal\.run' | head -1)
75|  [ -z "$URL" ] && { echo "no URL, abort"; exit 1; }
76|  for i in {1..90}; do
77|    code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" -m 60 -H "Authorization: Bearer $K" "$URL/v1/models")
78|    [ "$code" = "200" ] && { date +"ready %T (try $i)"; break; }
79|    sleep 20
80|  done
81|  [ "$code" != "200" ] && { echo "Forge not ready after 30 min, abort"; exit 1; }
82|fi
83|PY=~/projects/forge/.venv/bin/python
84|DEV_JOBS=~/projects/forge/experiments/factory/jobs_dev.jsonl
85|run() {
86|  # Refuse-to-start check only (verifier D1): the runner gets the whole
87|  # cap and enforces the reserve itself, so time and reserve are no
88|  # longer subtracted twice.
89|  "$PY" -I "$COMMON/budget_left.py" "$CAP" "$GPU_START" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "budget left for this runner call: CAP REACHED"; echo "CAP REACHED, not starting runner"; return 1; }
90|  FORGE_URL="$URL" FORGE_KEY="$K" $PY -I ~/projects/forge/experiments/final/runner_final.py --workers 8 --budget "$CAP" --gpu-start "$GPU_START" "$@" & RPID=$!
91|  wait $RPID
92|  rc=$?
93|  RPID=""
94|  echo "runner exit $rc $(date +%T)"
95|  return $rc
96|}
97|runspec() {  # "<jobs>:<subdir>:<arms>:<k>" -> runner args
98|  local spec=$1
99|  local jobs=${spec%%:*}; local rest=${spec#*:}
100|  local sub=${rest%%:*}; rest=${rest#*:}
101|  local arms=${rest%%:*}; local k=${rest##*:}
102|  if [ "$jobs" = "dev" ]; then
103|    run --jobs-file "$DEV_JOBS" --out "$OUT/$sub" --arms "$arms" --k "$k"
104|  else
105|    run --jobs "$jobs" --out "$OUT/$sub" --arms "$arms" --k "$k"
106|  fi
107|}
108|if [ -n "$PILOT" ]; then
109|  date +"pilot start %T"
110|  runspec "$PILOT"
111|  echo "PILOT DONE: waiting for $OUT/GO or $OUT/STOP (20 min max)"
112|  for i in {1..120}; do
113|    [ -e "$OUT/GO" ] && break
114|    [ -e "$OUT/STOP" ] && { echo "STOP requested"; exit 0; }
115|    sleep 10
116|  done
117|  [ ! -e "$OUT/GO" ] && { echo "no GO within 20 min, stopping"; exit 0; }
118|  date +"main start %T"
119|fi
120|for spec in "${RUNS[@]}"; do
121|  runspec "$spec" || exit $?
122|done
123|date +"done %T"

1|"""Serve the trained Forge model (base + merged LoRA) with vLLM on Modal.
2|
3|Same settings as deploy/modal_glimmer.py (A100-80GB, the same vLLM image
4|and flags, max-model-len 32768, max_containers 1, 5-minute scale-down,
5|secret forge-glimmer with VLLM_API_KEY), except:
6|
7|- app ``forge-trained`` (stopped after every session: no idle GPU);
8|- the model path is /vol/<name>/merged from the ``forge-lora`` volume
9|  (<name> from env FORGE_MODEL_NAME, default ``final``);
10|- the served name is ``forge`` (what runner_final.py asks for).
11|
12|    FORGE_MODEL_NAME=final modal deploy deploy/modal_forge.py
13|    modal app stop forge-trained   # after every session
14|"""
15|
16|import os
17|import subprocess
18|
19|import modal
20|
21|MODEL_NAME = os.environ.get("FORGE_MODEL_NAME", "final")
22|MODEL_PATH = "/vol/%s/merged" % MODEL_NAME
23|SERVED_NAME = "forge"
24|GPU = "A100-80GB"
25|SCALEDOWN_S = 300
26|PORT = 8000
27|MINUTES = 60
28|
29|# Modal needs `python` + `pip` on PATH; the vLLM image only ships `python3`
30|# (same fix as deploy/modal_glimmer.py).
31|image = modal.Image.from_registry(
32|    "vllm/vllm-openai:muse-glimmer",
33|    setup_dockerfile_commands=[
34|        'RUN ln -sf "$(command -v python3)" /usr/local/bin/python'
35|        ' && (python -m pip --version || python -m ensurepip)',
36|    ],
37|).entrypoint([])
38|hf_cache = modal.Volume.from_name("forge-hf-cache", create_if_missing=True)
39|vllm_cache = modal.Volume.from_name("forge-vllm-cache", create_if_missing=True)
40|lora_vol = modal.Volume.from_name("forge-lora", create_if_missing=True)
41|
42|app = modal.App("forge-trained")
43|
44|
45|@app.function(
46|    image=image,
47|    gpu=GPU,
48|    scaledown_window=SCALEDOWN_S,
49|    timeout=30 * MINUTES,
50|    max_containers=1,  # one GPU at most: a hard ceiling on spend rate
51|    secrets=[modal.Secret.from_name("forge-glimmer")],
52|    volumes={"/root/.cache/huggingface": hf_cache,
53|             "/root/.cache/vllm": vllm_cache,
54|             "/vol": lora_vol},
55|)
56|@modal.concurrent(max_inputs=16)
57|@modal.web_server(port=PORT, startup_timeout=25 * MINUTES)
58|def serve():
59|    # VLLM_API_KEY from the secret makes vLLM require "Authorization: Bearer <key>"
60|    subprocess.Popen([
61|        "vllm", "serve", MODEL_PATH,
62|        "--served-model-name", SERVED_NAME,
63|        "--host", "0.0.0.0", "--port", str(PORT),
64|        "--tensor-parallel-size", "1",
65|        "--max-model-len", "32768",
66|        "--enable-auto-tool-choice",
67|        "--tool-call-parser", "muse_glimmer",
68|        "--reasoning-parser", "muse_glimmer",
69|        "--generation-config", "auto",
70|    ])

26|  {verdict (0.2%, checks.TOL_DIFF), tight (1e-6), fails, measurements}. For first-test it scores against expected.json

29|  Prints `REFS n/n PASS`.
30|- `--regrade <baseline results dir>`: re-run each recorded answer's code (from calls.jsonl) in the box, grade it, and
31|  write regrade.json with old verdict, new verdict (0.2%) and new tight (1e-6), per answer (the 199 final
32|  answers: BR 30, B2 90, BX 79), plus a measure-equality column: box measurements vs the recorded ones at the

39|- Reference programs and the generator's own self-checks (valid solids, wrong variants fail) are trusted generator
40|  code and may run locally in tests.
41|- cached tokens: read `usage["prompt_tokens_details"]["cached_tokens"]` when present, else `usage["cached_tokens"]`,
42|  else 0. Test with the real Baseten usage shape (numbers illustrative):
43|  `{"prompt_tokens": 8307, "completion_tokens": 3438, "prompt_tokens_details": {"cached_tokens": 7552}}`.
44|- `make_jobs.py` also writes the 20 dev jobs as a jobs file usable by §3 (`--jobs-file`).
45|

47|- Import from experiments/first-test/runner.py (frozen, unchanged): SYSTEM_PROMPT, build_messages, build_body,
48|  the code extraction, the summary/statistics helpers. Arm FT = arm A's messages (system + job text, no manual, no

61|- `runner_final.py --arms BX --fill-missing results/bmax-baseline-2026-10-29/main-B2BX`: run only the (job, rep)
62|  pairs with no BX final record (expected: H12 ×2, H13-H15 ×3 = 11), endpoint GLIMMER_URL/GLIMMER_KEY (base Glimmer).
63|- Same loop as the frozen runner.do_bx_call: import build_messages("BX", …), build_bx_body, bx_self_check_message,
64|  BX_MAX_CALLS, BX_ERROR_HEAD, the examples and hint from the frozen files. The only change: each program runs in the
65|  cloud box, which returns (run_error, measure) in the same measure format as run_code_sandboxed (xmin…zmax, volume,
66|  solids), and the verdict comes from the cloud grader. Write per-round + final records like run_suite does.
67|- Test: with fake model replies and a fake executor, the cloud BX loop sends exactly the same message list, round by
68|  round, as runner.do_bx_call does with the same fake executor (build, run error, self-check, no-code-block end).
69|- Default `--workers 12` for `--fill-missing` (one wave). If fewer final records than missing pairs exist at the end,
70|  exit 3 with "INCOMPLETE: ask the user" and write no summary that compare.py would accept.
71|- Log the vLLM image digest (from the server) into summary.json for every session.
72|- compare.py merges these records with the baseline BX records (no (job, rep) twice; refuses on a duplicate).
73|
74|## 4. Exam guard on the cloud box
75|forge_train.py's code check (run_train_code / default_train_meas) gets a hook to use cloud_cq's box for the training
76|record's code (measurements back from the grader-side measure of the BREP). The local sandbox path is removed for
77|training records. Exam references are still built in-process (trusted jobs.py). Test with a fake box.
78|
79|## 5. C1 fix in experiments/freecad/runner_fc.py
80|`cached_tokens_of` reads the nested Baseten field first (same rule as §2). Test with the real usage shape above.
81|
82|## 6. `deploy/modal_forge.py`: serve the trained model
83|Copy of deploy/modal_glimmer.py's settings (A100-80GB, same vLLM image and flags, max-model-len 32768, max_containers
84|1, 5-min scale-down, secret forge-glimmer) except: app `forge-trained`, model path `/vol/<name>/merged` from the
85|`forge-lora` volume (name from env FORGE_MODEL_NAME, default `final`), served name `forge`.
86|And `experiments/final/run_final_session.sh`: same behaviour as experiments/freecad/run_fc_session.sh (deploy, wait
87|ready, optional pilot + GO/STOP, whole-session cap with reserve, trap that always stops the app and prints it), for
88|runner_final.py with app forge-trained.
89|
90|## 7. `experiments/final/compare.py`: the pre-registered decision (PLAN step 6)
91|Inputs: FT's run dir and the baseline dirs results/bmax-baseline-2026-10-29/main-B2BX and main-BR. Paired bootstrap
92|over the 30 jobs (10,000 resamples, seed 20261029), per-job pass rate over that arm's answers (BX uses the answers it
93|has). If any of the 30 jobs still has no BX answer, compare.py refuses (exit 2) and names the jobs. Tokens per correct part are printed
94|split into prompt and completion; bar (d) prints wall-clock and $ per correct part first. Prints each bar (a)-(d) with the numbers and PASS/FAIL, then "CLAIM HOLDS" only if all four pass. Tables for
95|all/medium/hard. Tests: fake records for each bar at its boundary (−5, −15, 1.5×, ÷3) and one all-pass case, and the refusal
96|when a job has no BX answer.
97|
98|## Done when
99|- `~/projects/forge/.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q experiments/final experiments/factory experiments/freecad
100|  experiments/train experiments/common` passes (the old 150 plus the new tests).
101|- `runner_final.py --jobs main --out X` with no keys exits 2 with the missing-variable message, no network.
102|- `forge_train.py smoke --cap-dollars 2.0` still prints CAP REFUSED and exits 2.
103|Report: files changed, the pytest line, anything not followed.

12|# jobs "dev" means the factory dev file (experiments/factory/jobs_dev.jsonl);
13|# anything else means --jobs <jobs> on the exam. Default pilot is the dev
14|# check (PLAN step 5 gate) and the default run is the final exam (step 6).
15|#
16|# Each runner call starts in the background (cmd & RPID=$!; wait $RPID) so
17|# the EXIT/INT/TERM/HUP trap can always run. The trap kills the runner and
18|# its children (kill -TERM $RPID; pkill -TERM -P $RPID; macOS has no setsid),
19|# then always runs `modal app stop forge-trained -y` and prints whether it
20|# stopped.

28|CAP=3.0

30|  [0-9]* ) CAP=$1; shift;;
31|esac

33|RUNS=()
34|while [ $# -gt 0 ]; do
35|  case "$1" in

37|    --run) RUNS+=("$2"); shift 2;;
38|    *) echo "unknown arg $1"; exit 2;;
39|  esac
40|done

42|mkdir -p "$OUT"
43|cd ~/projects/forge
44|COMMON=~/projects/forge/experiments/common
45|MODAL_BIN=${MODAL_BIN:-modal}
46|K=$(python3 -I -c "import secrets;print(secrets.token_urlsafe(32))")
47|echo "key generated (never printed)"
48|RPID=""
49|CLEANED=""
50|cleanup() {  # runs once: kill the runner + children, then stop the app
51|  [ -n "$CLEANED" ] && return 0
52|  CLEANED=1
53|  if [ -n "$RPID" ]; then
54|    kill -TERM "$RPID" 2>/dev/null || true
55|    pkill -TERM -P "$RPID" 2>/dev/null || true

59|  else
